cards.p: The same budget buys the same 300 clicks both times. What changes is how many the listing can hold.
The early run loses $219.00 and produces 9 sales; the later run loses $57.00 and produces 27 sales. The difference is $162.00 and 18 sales.
The starting camp sees 18 sales of ranking the waiting seller never got, in the weeks when a new listing may be cheapest to rank.
Suppose you have 200 units and your campaigns drive 8 units a day. That is 25 days of supply.
